style: chunky flat charcoal ash humanoid, pale expressionless borrowed face with small ink eyes nose straight mouth, asymmetric shoulders and unequal long arms, narrow waist, no weapons no hood

move.action: Dragging pursuit cycle: torso leans right ahead of hips, shorter foot slides forward as long arm trails, trailing foot catches up while torso remains forward, settles toward initial pose. Not regular marching. Preserve asymmetrical arms and pale face, two feet grounded, stationary root.

attack.action: Empty hand grasp: leaning ready, long arm draws back slightly, long empty hand reaches far forward right to catch someone with open fingers, arm lowers into recovery. Face plate keeps looking right unchanged throughout. No weapon no extra arms no effects.

hit.action: Recoil: ready asymmetric body, shoulders and chest twist and compress, knees bend slightly while uneven arms droop, settles near ready. Pale face remains rigid unchanged with neutral ink features. No particles or anatomy additions.

dead.action: Collapse body before face: standing ready, knees fold and shoulders sag but pale face remains whole, charcoal body collapses into connected low heap with face just above touching heap, final pale face rests tilted atop body heap. Face falls last and stays visible, all parts touching, no detached floating elements.
